label: MSH-161 completed qualification extension ready for review
command: import json,pathlib; h=pathlib.Path("docs/m5/evidence/msh161"); s=json.loads((h/"extension-chain.json").read_text()); assert s["status"]=="completed_needs_review"; b=json.loads((h/"qualification-extension/batch.json").read_text()); assert len(b["pairs"])==8 and all(p["complete"] for p in b["pairs"]); assert all(json.loads((h/"qualification-extension"/p["id"]/"analysis-summary.json").read_text())["complete_query_coverage"] for p in b["pairs"]); print("Completed batch and all-move analysis validated")
cleanup_scope: Own child process group only; engines detached by existing helpers require their own receipts/reconciliation; not a descendant-tree cleanup guarantee
